summary: Existing extraction was dominated by AT2/AT1/fetal-tip/airway markers outside the L4 pulmonary neuroendocrine target. Active scan of the Markdown identified formal evidence for pulmonary neuroendocrine markers ASCL1, NEUROD1 and GRP in Fig. EV2 and scRNA-seq annotation. All non-target existing candidates are excluded; corrected marker table provided.

issues.description: Existing extraction lacked the pulmonary neuroendocrine markers ASCL1, NEUROD1 and GRP, which appear in Fig. EV2 marker expression UMAPs and were used for scRNA-seq annotation.
All existing formal candidates were AT2/AT1/fetal-tip/airway markers outside target_cell_scope L4:Pulmonary neuroendocrine cell; they are excluded from the corrected marker table.
HTII-280 is an antibody/antigen, not a gene symbol; cannot be normalized to a unique gene.
NASPA is a typographical variant of NAPSA and was normalized accordingly.

ASCL1 is displayed in the EV2 marker panel and is included as an NE-lineage marker from the same scRNA-seq annotation set; only NEUROD1 and GRP are explicitly labelled as 'neuroendocrine cells' in the figure legend.
